biomarker_test_results.result_description: Loss of expression of PMS2 proteins
MLH1 promoter methylation was not seen but sequencing identified the high risk variant
Reduced expression of the c.27A allele in three relatives carrying the variant

clinical_outcome.overall_recommendations: Predictive cascade genetic testing available for relatives. For carriers: full colonoscopy every two years from 25-75 years, screening for H. Pylori and eradication if present, consideration of low-dose aspirin, referral to CaPP3 if appropriate. Women with this familial haplotype should be offered prophylactic TAH and BSO from age 45 years. Consider inputting this family into the INSIGHT database and for publication in a peer-reviewed journal.
